scripts.dev: pnpm run build:workspace-deps && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning -e "process.argv.splice(1, 0, 'tsx'); import('tsx/cli')" -- watch --exclude "../../workspace/**" --exclude "../../.agentos/**" --exclude "../../agent-memory/**" src/index.ts
scripts.dev:stable: pnpm run build:workspace-deps && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --import tsx src/index.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build:workspace-deps && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/**/*.test.ts
